**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared reliance on Wnt signaling, despite different modes of dysregulation, could reveal therapeutic strategies targeting this pathway for both FAP management (e.g., prevention of polyp formation) and colorectal cancer treatment (e.g., inhibiting tumor growth and metastasis).
